hidden_tests.description: The model evaluates without feature errors
Evaluates cleanly and every body is a valid closed solid
A plausible amount of material (5 to 800 cm³)

questions: Which phone is it (or how big), and how thick is it with its case?
Portrait, landscape or both, and at what viewing angle?
Should it leave room for a charging cable?
clarify.assumptions: A typical 6.5" phone in a case (~12 mm thick), portrait, leaning back ~23°: a one-piece side profile 90 mm deep and 66 mm tall with a 12 mm slot, extruded 75 mm.
